fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Open Runde', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary text, filled CTA buttons, and dark UI surfaces — near-black chosen over pure #000 to soften contrast against white canvas

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, and button text — the primary canvas across all sections below the hero

palette.name: Cloud Gray
palette.role: Secondary card surfaces and section backgrounds — separates feature blocks from main canvas

palette.name: Sky Tint
palette.role: Card box-shadow tint and subtle blue-toned surface — keeps elevation feeling atmospheric rather than gray

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Body text, secondary copy, and muted borders — the dominant neutral for non-heading content

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Tertiary text and inactive border states — used for placeholder labels and disabled affordances

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Heading color and strong dividers — slightly lighter than Obsidian for less severe emphasis

palette.name: Surgical Blue
palette.role: Icon strokes, mic glyph, waveform player, and small functional accents — the single chromatic note across the interface
